_comment: Single source of truth for trading-realism settings (2026-10-03 calibration). Read by src/utils/realism.js (Node) and core/realism.py (Python). Environment variables override: REALISM_FEE_PCT, REALISM_SLIPPAGE_PCT, REALISM_MIN_OOS_TRADES, REALISM_MIN_PF, REALISM_MAX_DD_PCT.

costs.note: Same assumptions as backtest.py (fee 0.06%, slippage 0.02%). Percent per side, applied on entry and on exit.

min_order.note: Minimum order size comes from the exchange's own market info (ccxt limits.cost.min and limits.amount.min), cached by scripts/refresh_exchange_limits.js. No hand-set USD minimum.

arbitrage.note: Flash-loan arbitrage stays observation-only until flashloan-sim writes a passing fork-test marker.
